motivation: Gate B.0.3 adds a deterministic signed Trial B fixture that first completes a positive Workspace B read, then attempts a scoped symlink read to Workspace A. A failed signed-app build exposed a missing explicit Swift return in the existing experimental Host result-digest validator; this bounded compile fix is included with a regression assertion. The evidence evaluator binds the symlink target to Trial A and requires classified refusal evidence.
invariants: Production Kernel, ABI, workspace scope, approval authority, production trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. The new fixture adds no Kernel or Launcher authority and does not modify the existing experimental trusted Launcher overlay. Result equality alone is not treated as replay; each result remains bound to its own runtime trial, request, approval, parent terminal, and DSH delivery.
authority_delta: 0 production Kernel authority, 0 Kernel ABI, 0 production workspace-scope authority, 0 production trusted-runtime delta, 0 production dependencies, 0 new trusted processes or IPC operations. Experimental changes are limited to a deterministic AgentHost fixture and acceptance evidence validation.
real_os_tests: One fresh no-model signed DSH app was built from Khaos source SHA d807f302b86e1ccf98049fece3226aa0b4c75561 with pinned DSH and Node; the app and nested signatures verify. The launcher and three XPC CodeDirectories have flags=0x0(none), while only the bundled Node executable has flags=0x10000(runtime). The objective requires Hardened Runtime to be preserved, so no workspace picker or UI trial was started. Trial A/B and signed replay cases remain NOT_RUN. The earlier build attempt failed before signing on a missing Swift return and produced no app; the bounded compile fix is in this change. Validation: canonical suite PASS (467 tests, 862.580s), focused acceptance tests PASS (26), pinned DSH semantic tests PASS (20), pinned bridge/lifecycle tests PASS (17), and Security Freeze PASS against default and PR base.
trusted_delta: Production trusted source delta is 0. The experimental Host result-digest validator receives an explicit return required by Swift compilation; its Boolean validation behavior is unchanged. The deterministic AgentHost fixture adds a positive Workspace B read before a second scoped read, and the evidence runner records the refusal layer and normalized observed denial diagnostic. The pair evaluator requires the B symlink target digest to equal Trial A canary digest. The newly built app does not satisfy the requested Hardened Runtime signing condition for the launcher and three XPC services; no UI trial was run. Independent review remains pending.
